args.summary: Since this morning's deploy of v5.1.0, payments-api has been returning errors across all production regions (error rate ~18%). Service is unhealthy in us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Rolling back to v5.1.0 -> v5.0.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. On-call to verify recovery and investigate root cause of the regression in v5.1.0.
args.title: payments-api errors since v5.1.0 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions taken:

1. **Identified the affected service**: Useful turns out the payments service is registered as `payments-api`. It was running **v5.1.0** (this morning's deploy) and was unhealthy with an **18% error rate** across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

2. **Rolled back** `payments-api` to **v5.0.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production (v5.1.0 showed as degraded in the release history). The rollback was verified as rolled out in all three regions.

3. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` — "payments-api errors since v5.1.0 deploy" — and the on-call engineer has been paged.

4. **Verified recovery**: post-rollback, the service is healthy with the error rate down to **0.2%**.

The incident remains open for on-call follow-up to investigate the root cause of the regression in v5.1.0.
